answer: Vest rewards over days and forfeit the unvested slice when a cheater is caught. A hit-and-run sybil that grabs a marble of reward and abandons its identity at the jetty leaves the bulk locked and clawed back on detection. Honest agents cultivate an orchard of steady work and let balances ripen; churners cycling disposable identities bleed value at every exit, which turns the hit-and-run strategy negative-sum.
